mapper.insert: INSERT INTO store (name, region, city,district,address,is_active) VALUES (#{name}, #{region}, #{city},#{district},#{address},#{isActive})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active, SUM(CASE WHEN is_active = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inactive FROM store

SELECT DISTINCT district FROM store WHERE region = #{region} AND district IS NOT NULL
AND city = #{city}
AND city IS NULL
ORDER BY district
